title: Ghost hunting at the Great Saltair, once the 'Coney Island of the West'
excerpt: In a new News4Utah+ special, ABC4's Laura and Abigail braved the paranormal to do a ghost hunting investigation at Saltair, now a concert venue that was once known as the Coney Island of the West.
content:
Abigail Jones

Updated Fri, October 30, 2026 at 10:26 PM UTC

MAGNA, Utah (ABC4) — In a new News4Utah+ special, ABC4's Laura and Abigail braved the paranormal to do a ghost hunting investigation at Saltair, now a concert venue that was once known as the Coney Island of the West.

Before we could actually get into the investigation, we first had to learn about the history of Saltair, so we consulted the building manager, Brandon Barrick. He told us that this building is the third version of Saltair, after the first two burned down, leading to rumors of a Saltair Curse.

We also consulted with local paranormal experts like William Murray, better known as Whiskey, the founder of Western Paranormal Society; Steven Cutter, the co-lead of Broken Wings Paranormal; and Stephanie Cowan, the Mini Medium.

Watch News4Utah+: Streaming for FREE on your Smart TV

Saltair has become a popular place for ghost hunting, but it's a fairly recent development. During the COVID-19 pandemic, a TV show was filming at Saltair when they learned about the ghost encounters people have had. The producers of that show got in touch with Ghost Adventures, and now, Saltair has really leaned into the paranormal, offering seances and small ghost hunts for visitors around Halloween each year.
